cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's the only room missing from the timeline.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll give the cake its own line. First, your kitchen time.

mechanism: A leads a party account and broadens record taking after suspicion, supplying headings and notes without naming which kitchen answer matters most.
confusable: Unlike interrogating openly about the cake, A keeps seeking a complete timeline and companions instead of confessing the priority.
comparison: A party timeline and room history differ from vehicle entries requiring a physical logbook fetch.
seedUse: D174-a party report, kitchen and missing cake reauthored to avoid repeated priority disclosure; S02-a does the record-writing work.
